correctness.rationale: For all N>=5, group rotation averaging reduces the optimum to one coefficient. A strict trigonometric smoothing identity classifies every discrete three-gap minimizer with the sole neutral even-gap case resolved by a second decrease, proving the exact value and contact counts. Every original optimizer must vanish at all six/ two minimum Fourier modes; explicit determinant formulas verify unique six-real-parameter solution off resonance, while the two resonant equalities leave four independent feasible parameters because the symmetric optimizer is strictly positive on other modes. Taylor expansions prove cubic signed correction. The packaged checker directly reproduced all 247035 Fourier positivity comparisons and 17 full six-variable linear programs. Finite checks are not substituted for the global proof.

value.rationale: The natural seven-point root-hexagon support gives the first small two-dimensional positive-definite Turán extremal geometry beyond one-dimensional cyclic intervals. The exact all-order Fourier-grid optimum has a sharp arithmetic equality barrier, and the full complex optimizer set jumps from one point to a four-dimensional convex face exactly at resonance. Signed third-order correction quantifies frequency-grid aliasing in two distinct arithmetic classes. This supplies a motivated infinite-family classification and structural rigidity result, not a known-table recomputation or arbitrary finite slice.
